import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { area } from "./area";
import { tag } from "./tag";

// Introspected as an owned-child: belongs to area (the leading column of a primary key made only of foreign keys) and nothing else references it.
export const areaTag = defineTable("area_tag", {
    columns: {
        area: col.integer().primaryKey(),
        tag: col.integer().primaryKey(),
        count: col.integer().notNull(),
        lastUpdated: col.timestamptz().onCreateNow()
    },
    relations: {
        areaRelation: rel.belongsTo(() => area, { localKey: "area", onDelete: "no action" }),
        tagRelation: rel.belongsTo(() => tag, { localKey: "tag", onDelete: "no action" })
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
